gap_classification.notes: No official own-domain website found for Salem Urban Co-operative Bank Ltd (Tamil Nadu). Searches return only aggregators (codeforbanks) and an unrelated US bank (salemcoop.com, New Hampshire). Note: salemdccb.bank.in is a DIFFERENT bank (Salem District Central Co-operative Bank, a DCCB), not this urban co-op. Registry hint 'dnb.com' is a directory. No retrievable official rate page.
